properties.description:
The complement of `cap:a-repair-can-say-what-it-invalidated`, and the reason that one sat unused. That capability lets a record SAY it answered a finding. This one makes the saying happen: it computes which open observations a session's work touched that nobody has claimed, tells the skills to ask, and puts the question in front of the session that did the work.

WHY IT IS A SEPARATE CAPABILITY. #321 shipped the edge WITH its reader, deliberately, so the marker would not become a comment nobody consults — and a day later, with the tool served the whole time, **zero edges had ever been drawn.** A vocabulary reaches real work only with three legs: a typed TOOL, an INSTRUCTION that names it, and a COMPUTATION THAT NOTICES ITS ABSENCE. #321 built the first. This is the other two, and they are a different thing to build, test and get wrong.

WHAT IT IS:
  • `unclaimed_findings` — given the ChangeEvent ids a session recorded, the OPEN TemporalFacts their changed subjects carry that nothing has claimed. Reads the `subject_id` PROPERTY as well as the subject edges, which is most of the coverage: 151 of 270 open observations are reachable by edge (56%), 261 once the property is read (97%).
  • `capture-session` test 7 and `impact-check` step 4 name the tool and the moment.
  • The Stop hook's async probe asks it and RIDES ALONG on a nudge already firing, or is carried to the next SessionStart.

⭐ ASK, DON'T BLOCK — Anthony 2026-08-24. It never arms an interruption of its own; it only appends to a message already going out. A brand-new trigger keyed on a computation nobody has field-tested is exactly what becomes wallpaper. 🛑 The honest cost: a non-blocking Stop message reaches the TRANSCRIPT, not the agent, so the two paths that genuinely reach one are the ride-along and the next SessionStart.

🛑 EVERY ROW IS A CANDIDATE AND NEVER A VERDICT. Nothing infers that an observation is false — only that the thing it describes has moved and nobody has said either way. The judgement is the author's.

🛑 TEMPORAL FACTS ONLY, NEVER VERIFICATIONS, and it is NOT a gap source. That is what keeps it from reversing `dec:verification-freshness-not-a-gap`: a stale-looking CHECK is a standing property that fires on every refactor; a TemporalFact is a dated OBSERVATION, asserted once, re-derived by nothing.

MEASURED BOUNDS, stated rather than glossed: 71% of this design's 639 ChangeEvents touch no open observation at all and the median when one is touched is 1 — but mean 4.3, p90 13, max 40, because hub subjects carry many observations each (`proj:reflow2` alone has 25). Work that records no ChangeEvent, or one with no CHANGED edges, is unreachable, as are the 9 observations whose `subject_id` names a node that does not exist.
properties.name: The graph asks what a session made FALSE, so a finding that has been acted on stops proposing work already done
